sourceTitle: The Sylphs of the Season with Other Poems
description: "The Sylphs of the Seasons with Other Poems" by Washington Allston is a collection of poetic works written in the early 19th century, during the Romantic era. The anthology primarily revolves around themes of nature, love, and the mystical relationship between humanity and the elements of the seasons.
